name: online.autorig.cloth
description: Secondary motion for rigged characters: hair, skirts, capes, tails and accessories simulated on bone chains. Reads the .autorig-cloth.json manifests AutoRig.online writes next to rigged models, so AutoRig characters get working cloth with no manual setup. Includes body colliders, wind, automatic chain detection and a procedural demo.

samples.description: An empty-scene demo: a procedural character with a skirt, hair and a cape that walks, turns and jumps.
